question: Where can I find hotel inside 80 kilometers while progressing from Acushnet Sawmill, Acushnet, MA toward Drive By Projects, Watertown, MA?
sql: SELECT poi_name, addr_state, addr_city FROM pois WHERE tourism = 'hotel' AND ST_Intersects( pois.geometry::geography, ST_Buffer( ST_MakeLine( ( SELECT geometry::geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Acushnet Sawmill%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Acushnet%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%MA%' LIMIT 1 ), ( SELECT geometry::geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Drive By Projects%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Watertown%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%MA%' LIMIT 1 ) )::geography, 80000 ) );
